rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a hatching/hatched Day-5 blastocyst consistent with 4AB and appropriately describes strong ICM and looser TE; minor limitation is some reliance on the provided Gardner grade rather than strictly image-only features.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, FSH, tubal factor diagnosis, first-cycle status, sperm quality, oocyte yield, and lifestyle with embryo quality to frame prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with conclusions generally supported by embryo grade and patient factors; slight overconfidence in the implantation estimate and some speculative comments about TE/placentation prevent a perfect score.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice, especially support for single embryo transfer in a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst; minor deviations include somewhat broad suggestions about immunologic/thrombophilia workup and optional PGT-A framing.

Provides clear next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, endometrial assessment, luteal support, and future-cycle review; useful but not highly tailored beyond standard IVF management.
